topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the topic of complement and sets expectations for the lecture.

topics.label: Fundamentals of complement and the central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the basic architecture, naming conventions, and pivotal central molecule of the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three upstream recognition pathways that trigger complement activation.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream processes through which activated complement mediates pathogen clearance.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms that protect host cells from bystander complement damage.

topics.label: Clinical manifestations of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the distinct medical presentations and disease vulnerabilities caused by deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the strategies pathogens use to circumvent complement attack and how these bacterial factors are applied in medicine and biotechnology.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on the adaptive immune system.
